Four original destinations and all account tabs retain selected-loan context
Explicit preference persists on refresh and navigation
System follows live Chrome OS-media changes; explicit Light/Dark override OS
Keyboard type-ahead selection, visible focus and record-tab keyboard navigation
Cold load blocks hydration JS; first-body theme and body color match saved preference even when OS disagrees
Invalid values and blocked localStorage fall back to OS; current-tab switching still works
Reduced motion disables actual repayment drawer animation; no monetary animation
Actual clipboard readback matches displayed loan ID and visible Copied feedback
Held actual balance GET shows refresh state, then continues to real backend
No document overflow across five major layouts at each width; wide tables scroll locally
financial_validation: Existing principal/interest reconciliation and balanced journal assertions retained
10000-paise principal at annual nominal 0.12 over two monthly periods; first due principal 4975 paise
1000-paise repayment on first due date allocates 100 interest and 900 principal; actual remaining principal 9100 paise, recognized interest and penalty zero
Same-key retry and source alias retain one receipt and original journal
Different payload gives actual 409; auditor mutation gives actual 403
Atomic overpayment rejection, single manager disbursement and audit actor attribution
Dropped HTTP response after real commit; exact retry after reload and edited form retains original receipt
iteration_history: First theme suite had six ambiguous cell assertions before tab route completion, plus a native select Home-key assumption on Mac Chrome. Tests now wait for the repayment heading and use verified native keyboard type-ahead. Final full production rerun passed with zero retries. Initial screenshot captures froze transient theme colors; final evidence completes animations. A direct Prettier SVG invocation needed its built-in HTML parser; final formatting check passed.
limitations: Existing list/search API absent; current-tab history remains capped at 12
Loan audit scan remains capped at 5000 global records
Before/after reads are not an atomic snapshot
Storage-disabled preferences cannot persist across reload
System behavior verified using Chrome OS-media emulation, not changing macOS appearance settings
Physical devices, Safari/Firefox and full assistive-technology certification not performed
Future strict production CSP would require a nonce/hash for the static bootstrap
Demo impersonation remains development-only, not production security
